resources.source_ref: NIST STAR 1.2 official archive https://physics.nist.gov/PhysRefData/Star/STAR.tar.gz, retained at research/nist_star_20261031/STAR.tar.gz; native ESTAR material 013 ALUMINUM default grid
resources.verification_note: All 81 rows match official STAR 1.2 ESTAR output exactly in electron kinetic energy (MeV), total mass stopping power (MeV cm2/g), CSDA mass range (g/cm2), and the redundant mg/cm2 range. Native -O0 and -O2 output bytes are identical. Proof: outputs/nist_estar_reproduction_final_20261101/report.json, SHA256 4486fbed685636712d8264f4c9aa17e9022f2b6bd6d33b2e0a80c310c5deeeee; compiler, source members, runner and parser fingerprints are retained there. The unchanged CSV retains its historical workbook ancestry: ЛПЭ.xlsx, sheet e_Al, 522688 bytes, SHA256 d4ed7928331a0b7abcdfe1b585504b136809a3f6823f220edfed8967c28ec684. The derivation command rebuilds and exactly verifies, rather than rewriting the existing numeric CSV or its legacy text formatting; its output directory must not already exist. This closes this table's provenance only, not complete spectral transport or physical accuracy qualification. Historical reports retain their original manifest fingerprints and are not repinned.

resources.source_ref: Local normalization workbook ЛПЭ.xlsx, sheet p_Al; upstream proton-data artifact/version not yet retained
resources.verification_note: All 157 rows reproduce exactly after canonical LF normalization from the identified workbook. Energy and range are monotonic, but authoritative upstream provenance remains open.

resources.source_ref: Local normalization workbook ЛПЭ.xlsx, sheet p_Si; upstream proton-data artifact/version not yet retained
resources.verification_note: All 105 rows reproduce exactly after canonical LF normalization. The source sheet contains collisional and radiative stopping, not nuclear stopping; therefore every nuclear LET entry remains zero and total LET completeness is not established. Interpolation metadata describes the existing piecewise linear energy-to-total-LET runtime; correcting the former log-log label changes neither numerical data nor physics and does not qualify this provisional source.

resources.source_ref: Local normalization workbook ЛПЭ.xlsx, sheet i_R_Al; upstream ion-transport artifact/version not yet retained
resources.verification_note: All 1845 rows reproduce exactly after canonical LF normalization. Values are smooth for the 15 selected ions, but authoritative upstream provenance and the intended ion coverage remain open.

resources.source_ref: Local normalization workbook ЛПЭ.xlsx, sheets i_Si_e and i_Si_n; workbook itself contains the invalid high-energy extension
resources.verification_note: All 1845 rows reproduce exactly after canonical LF normalization, proving the defect originates in the workbook rather than CSV conversion. All 15 ions show a nonphysical 3.5-4.2 decade electronic-LET collapse immediately above 10 GeV total ion energy; 270 rows remain quarantined. An older 106-row workbook copy ends at 10 GeV but is not an authoritative replacement.

resources.source_ref: tendl/p-Al027.tendl.txt; TENDL-2025 EVAL-MAY25 REV1
resources.verification_note: Regenerated from the retained official ENDF with radar.nuclear.tendl; all values match exactly after canonical LF normalization. All 24 retained MF=3 TAB1 sections declare ENDF INT=2. Source-authentic duplicate boundary energies are represented as typed one-sided discontinuities: interpolation approaches the first ordinate from the left and leaves from the second ordinate on the right; no threshold ramp or keep-max collapse is permitted.

resources.source_ref: tendl/p-Al027.tendl.txt; TENDL-2025 EVAL-MAY25 REV1
resources.verification_note: Regenerated from the retained official ENDF; the retained LAW=1 energy-density projection and interpolation metadata match exactly after canonical LF normalization. Histogram-left outgoing and linear-linear incident laws are explicit; all 106 energy distributions normalize within 2e-6. The source section declares LCT=3, so retained outgoing energies are centre-of-mass energies and the compact CSV contains only f0(E_cm). It does not retain the angular/Kalbach coefficients required for the CM-to-LAB energy-angle transform and path-length transport; both remain explicit calculation-level blockers.
